# Boundaries

## Authority

The profile may add procedure, review criteria, mappings, and planned gate recipes. It may not declare pass, expand work scope, grant tools or effects, reduce assurance, approve a generic contract or slice, authorize execution, or claim release.

## Generic-object ownership

`ImplementationStructureContract` and `ExecutionSlice` identity, revision, scope, fixed decisions, delegated freedom, work, assertions, authority, and acceptance remain generic BBK semantics. `profileProjections.go` and the CLI outputs are replaceable views and evidence records, not another source of truth.

## Tool boundary

Preflight is static by default. `--run-tools` permits bounded offline interrogation using the locally available toolchain. The profile does not download Go, switch toolchains, install linters, alter dependencies, run planned gates during resolution, or mutate the repository.

## Review boundary

Structure review compares fixed decisions and consequential shape. Exact private file, helper, algorithm, and test-utility equality is not conformance. Missing consequential evidence is `BLOCKED`; it is not silently accepted.

## Mixed subjects

For mixed software/procedure/hardware/data work, the profile returns a bounded Go projection and names adjacent obligations. It does not pretend to own the whole realization.
